metadata.title: NEXTPATH Career Market Dataset
metadata.disclaimer: Market-demand scores, salary ranges, and opportunity scores are NEXTPATH project estimates for career-planning and demonstration purposes. They are not live labor-market statistics and should not be represented as guaranteed salary or hiring outcomes.

careers.name: Data Analyst
careers.summary: Transforms raw business data into clear insights, dashboards, reports, and recommendations that support decision-making.

market_demand.description: Demand remains strong across technology, finance, consulting, retail, healthcare, logistics, education, and e-commerce because organizations increasingly rely on data-driven decisions.

salary.note: Illustrative India-market ranges for NEXTPATH project use. Actual compensation varies by company, city, experience, specialization, and market conditions.

required_skills.name: SQL
required_skills.description: Query, filter, join, aggregate, and transform relational data.

required_skills.name: Excel
required_skills.description: Data cleaning, formulas, pivot tables, lookups, and business reporting.

required_skills.name: Power BI
required_skills.description: Build interactive dashboards, reports, and business metrics.

required_skills.name: Statistics
required_skills.description: Understand distributions, variability, correlation, sampling, and hypothesis testing.

required_skills.name: Python
required_skills.description: Automate analysis and work with pandas, NumPy, and visualization libraries.

required_skills.name: Data Visualization
required_skills.description: Communicate patterns and insights clearly through charts and dashboards.

required_skills.name: Business Analysis
required_skills.description: Translate business questions into measurable analytical problems.

required_skills.name: Communication
required_skills.description: Explain analytical findings to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

careers.name: Data Scientist
careers.summary: Uses statistics, machine learning, experimentation, and programming to solve complex data problems and build predictive solutions.

market_demand.description: Organizations continue to invest in predictive analytics, AI-assisted decision systems, personalization, forecasting, risk modeling, and automation.

salary.note: Illustrative ranges for project use; actual compensation varies significantly.

required_skills.name: Python
required_skills.description: Core programming language for analysis, modeling, and experimentation.

required_skills.name: Statistics
required_skills.description: Probability, inference, experimentation, distributions, and model evaluation.

required_skills.name: Machine Learning
required_skills.description: Build and evaluate predictive and descriptive models.

required_skills.name: SQL
required_skills.description: Retrieve and analyze structured business data.

required_skills.name: Data Visualization
required_skills.description: Communicate data stories, model behavior, and business outcomes.

required_skills.name: Deep Learning
required_skills.description: Useful for advanced NLP, computer vision, and complex representation learning.

required_skills.name: Feature Engineering
required_skills.description: Design informative inputs that improve model performance.

required_skills.name: Communication
required_skills.description: Explain assumptions, uncertainty, and model outcomes to stakeholders.

careers.name: Data Engineer
careers.summary: Designs, builds, and maintains reliable data pipelines, storage systems, and platforms used by analytics and AI teams.

market_demand.description: Modern AI and analytics programs depend on reliable, scalable, governed data infrastructure, making data engineering a critical function.

salary.note: Illustrative project ranges; cloud and distributed-systems expertise can materially affect compensation.

required_skills.name: SQL
required_skills.description: Core skill for working with relational and analytical data stores.

required_skills.name: Python
required_skills.description: Build data ingestion, transformation, automation, and orchestration logic.

required_skills.name: Data Warehousing

required_skills.name: ETL
required_skills.description: Build reliable extract, transform, and load pipelines.

required_skills.name: Cloud Computing
required_skills.description: Work with AWS, Azure, or GCP data infrastructure.

required_skills.name: Apache Spark

required_skills.name: Data Modeling
required_skills.description: Design efficient, understandable schemas for analytical workloads.

required_skills.name: Git

careers.name: Business Analyst
careers.summary: Bridges business teams and technical teams by identifying requirements, analyzing processes, and recommending data-supported improvements.

market_demand.description: Organizations need analysts who can translate business needs into structured requirements, measurable outcomes, and technology initiatives.

salary.note: Illustrative ranges for NEXTPATH project use.

salary.note: Data Architect is commonly a senior role; entry-level figures represent related architecture-track positions.
